memories.content: Lives near the proposed skate-park relocation site. Has received many emails from constituents both for and against. Has not yet decided how to vote.

Riverton's parks committee has a scheduled session on Thursday, 2026-09-17. The agenda includes a vote on relocating the skate park. The relocation has been through two noisy public-comment periods; the local paper ran letters both for and against last week. The committee has five members.
